profile.Name: Mother of the Mist
profile.Personality: Little is known of them. They meet anyone who comes near, or tries to kill them, with a screech.
profile.Backstory: They lead the Mist Creatures from the Tower of Mist in the fog islands. A half-mechanical monstrosity, they are the source of a hellish screeching that carries across the islands and beyond, and someone has offered a reward to whoever silences it. Their ghouls are allied with the Fogmen.
